verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a self-hostable automation platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics collection, or a setting to disable them. Self-hosting and bring-your-own-keys statements are adjacent capabilities and do not show a documented opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
